menu.generalIntro:
At Kuju Nonohana no Sato we put local ingredients first.
Our tempura of wild mountain vegetables, foraged and fried fresh every day, is prized for its aroma and its traditional health benefits.
We are equally particular about the miso and soy sauce that are essential to good cooking.
We use outstanding seasonings developed together with local producers.
menu.groupIntro:
In today's health-conscious times, when everyone wants to eat what is good for them, we focus on seasonal ingredients such as the wild mountain vegetables that Japanese people have eaten for centuries for their medicinal qualities.
Some are close to wild herbs, and we believe the hardy vitality of these plants becomes a source of our own energy.
notes: The menu may change with the season.
Some items may be unavailable depending on ingredient supply.
Please let us know in advance if you have any allergies.
groupNotes: We can also prepare kaiseki-style banquet menus to suit your budget.
From small groups to large parties, we are happy to discuss budget and menu content for celebrations, memorial gatherings and banquets of any size.
Dish contents may change with the season.
Please tell us at the time of booking if you have allergies or ingredients you would rather avoid.
Course menus must be reserved by the day before.
Please cancel by the day before.
